# B-0052 — Reject ambiguous duplicate header identities in standalone CSV rows

- type: STORY
- status: BACKLOG
- decision_maturity: DISCOVERED
- primary_domain: resources
- supporting_domains: unknown
- evidence_basis: REPOSITORY
- hard_dependencies: unknown
- pressure_dependencies: unknown
- operational_dependencies: unknown
- validation_level: NONE
- execution_authorization: NONE
- proposal: ../proposals/1caa2686-428f-4fdf-b052-f0b8382b44dc/proposal.json
- intake_review: ../proposals/1caa2686-428f-4fdf-b052-f0b8382b44dc/review-0001.json

## Problem / value

Current exported CsvRow admits exact duplicate header names: CsvRow(("id","id"),("first","last"))["id"] returns "first" while as_dict()["id"] returns "last". This inconsistency loses one cell in keyed mapping access. CsvFile and CsvCodec already reject duplicate headers, but public standalone construction bypasses those checks. Repair only standalone exact-name uniqueness admission in the existing model owner.

## Proposed benefit

Make positional, keyed and mapping views agree for every admitted standalone row. Reject exact duplicate names with ValueError after immutable input capture. Preserve exact case/spacing/Unicode spelling, cell order, existing width/type validation, conversion and codec/file behavior. A real one-file model repair with frozen public regressions and independent holdouts; no automatic installation.

## Uncertainty / unresolved semantics

No production data loss observed beyond authored in-memory API calls. Empty standalone rows and unique blank names are outside this repair and retain current behavior. No new normalization, CSV dialect, codec change, transaction, schema migration or broader header type policy. This is a newly reproduced model-owner defect, distinct from delivered NONNUMERIC proposal 67f7d086-86d9-400f-bfaf-d9bc4df9aea1. No earlier dispatch exists.

task.objective: Repair standalone CsvRow exact duplicate header admission only. Current CsvRow(("id","id"),("first","last")) produces conflicting row["id"] and as_dict()["id"] values. Reject exact duplicate header names with ValueError during construction, before an ambiguous row becomes usable. Preserve exact header spelling: case, whitespace and Unicode normalization are NOT identity transformations. Preserve all existing behavior for unique names, including standalone empty rows and unique blank names, immutable iterable input capture, widths, string cells, indexing, iteration, mapping and conversion. Keep CsvFile/CsvCodec and dialect behavior unchanged. Only the authorized existing Python implementation may change. Before editing acquire the complete current owner with read_source to satisfy its whole-resource witness. Use find_source/read_source_unit or bounded source reads for tests/dependencies as useful. Submit a precise grounded replacement; no tests or other files may be edited. Public acceptance is frozen; separately authored final acceptance is withheld. No reference patch is provided.

obligations.name: current-owner
obligations.predicate: Acquire the complete current immutable CSV model owner; preserve its exact-key row and file contracts while repairing duplicate standalone admission.

comparisons.name: duplicate-key
comparisons.derivation: Two cells with the same exact key cannot support unambiguous keyed and mapping access; no preferred repair is assumed.

comparisons.name: distinct-spellings
comparisons.derivation: Exact Python string keys preserve case, spacing and distinct Unicode spellings; no normalization is authorized.

comparisons.name: empty-standalone
comparisons.derivation: Empty standalone row currently has consistent empty positional and mapping views; preserve this outside-scope behavior.

tool_definitions.name: read_source
tool_definitions.description: Read half-open Unicode offsets; omit end for a byte-bounded remaining prefix.

tool_definitions.name: replace_source
tool_definitions.description: Propose an exact unique observed replacement; host admission is required.

tool_definitions.name: find_source
tool_definitions.description: Search scoped file/symbol/window metadata. Without query, page the outline. Prefer small named units; read_source_unit acquires their exact source. Metadata is not a source witness. offset pages results. A supplied path must be an exact authorized file-resource address, never a directory or prefix. Omit path to search authorized resources under the existing result limits.

tool_definitions.name: read_source_unit
tool_definitions.description: Read an exact current unit from find_source. Partial results report the next Unicode offset; use read_source for adjacent ranges. Select enclosing/file IDs from metadata only when needed. Source and request byte limits still apply.
